g.text: Alpha Financial Analyst — Demo tier HLD (deployed design)
ACCEPTED 2026-10-11 · ADR-0015 · scale to zero: nothing runs while idle · not deployed until the S10 entry criteria pass. The always-on design is the scale tier.
AWS · us-east-1 · no VPC, no NAT · every stateful component · billed per use
Amazon Bedrock · US cross-region inference profiles
each step: Fargate RunTask · public IP · no NAT
vectors → S3 Parquet first · alias swap after a refreshed count
WHAT KEEPS IT CHEAP, BOUNDED AND CORRECT
worst case ≈ $30 / month under the guards
deadline 10 min, expired lazily on read
Region loss = outage, documented, not built.
Cheapest mitigations: S3 CRR · backup copies
· warm standby (≈ free while idle here)
arrows: navy = request / state purple = model call (dashed = fallback) green = ingestion & release slate dashed = external source orange = edge red dashed = kill switch
